lore.short: A blade dancer in the battlefield.

skills.name: Air Superiority
skills.description: During flight, Fanny deals 10%-20% extra damage to enemies hit (scales with flying speed) and applies a stack of Prey Mark to them (up to 2 stacks) on each attack. Her subsequent skill hits on marked enemy heroes restore 8 energy per stack for her. The energy restoration is reduced if she hits multiple enemy heroes within a short period of time.

skills.name: Tornado Strike
skills.description: Fanny whirls her blades, dealing 275 (+85% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies.

skills.name: Steel Cable
skills.description:
Fanny shoots a cable in the target direction that pulls her to the first obstacle hit. She can cast this skill again within 2s until her energy runs out, and each successive recast within this period costs 2 less energy.

Fanny automatically casts Tornado Strike upon hitting an enemy mid-flight, as long as her energy is sufficient.

skills.name: Cut Throat
skills.description: Fanny leaps at the target enemy hero or Creep with her blades, dealing 400 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Each stack of Prey Mark on the target increases this damage by 30%.

assist.desc: Fanny works best with heroes that can chain AOE CC to keep the enemy pinned, such as Minotaur and Gatotkaca, so she can deal damage without interruption.

strong.desc: Fanny counters squishy heroes that lack targeted CC like Karrie and Irithel who cannot stop Fanny's extreme mobility while she bursts them down.

weak.desc: Fanny is countered by heroes that can restrict mobility, such as Kaja and Khufra, since they can easily shutdown her main advantage.
